title: 喜剧
visual: clear setup geography, readable props, controlled escalation, and precise reaction framing
performance: play the situation sincerely; let misunderstanding, timing, interruption, and reaction create humor
camera: hold setup long enough to read, cut to inserts and reactions at motivated comic beats
audio: native dialogue, prop sounds, environmental punctuation, and restrained musical accents
avoid: constant mugging, random sound effects, every shot ending with surprise face, explaining the joke
